subject: SignalCrest security intake — scheduling, questionnaire & evidence logistics
messages:
From: Alex Truong <alex.truong@signalcrest.com>
To: jasmine_liu@redwood-inference.com
Cc: security@signalcrest.com
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: Security intake + CAIQ/SIG questionnaire & evidence handoff

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks for the quick signup — we’re evaluating Redwood for a customer-facing feature and need to run through your CAIQ/SIG and sample evidence before procurement can sign off. Are you available for a 30–45m security intake next week? Our goals: walk the CAIQ, confirm where to upload artifacts (log samples, architecture diagrams), and establish evidence owners and SLA around access to logs for audits.

Initial questions we’d like to cover on the call:
- Which model variants run in the hosted environment vs. Dedicated/Private?
- Data residency and retention defaults for hosted API calls; how are customer logs segmented?
- KMS/HSM integrations & key separation for Private customers
- Any SOC 2 scope notes and whether you provide audited reports for Dedicated customers

We’re flexible Tue-Fri PST. Proposed times: Tue 11/10 9–11am or Wed 11/11 2–4pm. If you prefer, send a calendar invite with a conference link and we’ll confirm.

I attached the CAIQ draft we typically use so we can mark up who owns what.

Thanks,
Alex Truong
Head of Security Programs, SignalCrest
security@signalcrest.com

Attachment: signalcrest-questionnaire-v1.xlsx
From: jasmine_liu@redwood-inference.com
To: Alex Truong <alex.truong@signalcrest.com>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood-inference.com, marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: Security intake + CAIQ/SIG questionnaire & evidence handoff

Alex — thanks for reaching out and the CAIQ. Happy to run the intake.

We can do Wed 11/11 2:00pm PST — I’ll send a calendar invite. On the call I’ll be joined by Aditya (infrastructure/security) and Marissa (compliance/evidence). Suggested agenda:
1) Quick intros & scope (10m)
2) CAIQ walk: owner mapping + clarifying answers (20m)
3) Evidence handoff: where to upload, expected artifacts, sample logs (10m)
4) Next steps & timeline for SOC 2/attestation docs if needed (5m)

Pre-call ask: please confirm which artifact types you need first (architecture diagrams, access-control lists, sample logs, encryption key manifests, SOC 2 report request), and whether you have a preferred S3/Drive location for file transfers. We typically provide short-lived signed links for sample logs and a shared Drive folder for questionnaires.

I’ll attach our internal evidence checklist and a stub network diagram for reference. Talk soon.

— Jasmine Liu
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwood-inference.com
Redwood Inference — production-first inference runtime

Attachments: redwood-evidence-checklist.pdf, redwood-sample-arch-stub.png
From: aditya_rao@redwood-inference.com
To: Alex Truong <alex.truong@signalcrest.com>, jasmine_liu@redwood-inference.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: Security intake + CAIQ/SIG questionnaire & evidence handoff

Alex — looking forward to the call Wednesday. A few technical items I want to cover and prep for so we can keep the meeting focused:

Artifact owners (please confirm if SignalCrest needs us to redact anything):
- Network topology + peering details: Aditya Rao (infra)
- Sample access logs (API request/response samples, redacted tokens): Aditya Rao
- KMS integration / key usage: Security team (we’ll share KMS provider and key-rotation cadence)
- SOC 2 / attestation: Marissa Cole (compliance)

Couple of specifics that often come up from customers so you have answers pre-call:
- Hosted API: request telemetry (request id, timestamp, model_variant) retained for 30 days by default; Dedicated/Private retention configurable per contract. We provide short-lived signed URLs for log samples and can provide a CSV export of anonymized request logs.
- Encryption: hosted uses provider-managed keys at rest by default; Private deployments can integrate customer KMS (AWS KMS / GCP KMS) with customer-managed keys — HSM-backed options available on Dedicated.
- Model variants: we’ll quickly map the options (open quantized variants vs. higher-fidelity variants) and notes on which are in-scope for SOC 2 if you need.

I’m attaching a small sample CSV (anonymized) of access logs and a diagram we'll refine on the call. If you have specific SIG question IDs you want to resolve during the meeting, paste them into the Drive link so we can annotate live.

-Aditya
Aditya Rao
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood-inference.com

Attachments: access-logs-sample.csv, network-architecture-diagram.pdf
From: marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com
To: Alex Truong <alex.truong@signalcrest.com>, jasmine_liu@redwood-inference.com, aditya_rao@redwood-inference.com
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 15:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: Security intake + CAIQ/SIG questionnaire & evidence handoff — confirmed

Alex / team — confirmed for Wed 11/11 2:00pm PST (invite sent). Zoom link + shared Drive folder attached in the calendar invite. Quick summary & action items ahead of the call:

1) Meeting details:
- When: Wed 11/11/2026 2:00–2:45pm PST
- Link: https://zoom.us/j/9876543210 (in invite)
- Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3SignalCrestEvidence

2) Evidence we will share during/shortly after the call:
- Network diagram (Redwood) — aditya_rao
- Anonymized access logs (CSV, 7-day sample) — aditya_rao
- CAIQ annotated answers (editable spreadsheet) — jasmine_liu
- SOC 2 summary + description of scope (if requested) — marissa_cole

3) Requests for SignalCrest (please upload to Drive by EOD Tue):
- Any SIG/CAIQ question IDs you want prioritized in the call
- Auditor contact if you plan to initiate a vendor assessment

4) Next steps after the call:
- We’ll tag CAIQ rows with owners and target turnaround for fill/attachments (typical SLA 5 business days for standard questions).
- For log/sample requests requiring longer retention or deeper exports, we’ll open a secure transfer ticket and estimate time.

If anything else is needed before the call (e.g., additional identities to include on the invite), reply-all. Looking forward to the conversation.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Compliance Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com
